_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Nang chye le Player {player_id}, Iterated Ultimatum Game {num_rounds} rounds kau ya ai.
Nang chye le ${pool} kau split kau ya ai round kau le Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Offer kau: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Accepted kau → Nang chye le $(pool - X), nang mai chye le $X
  - Rejected kau → Both chye le $0
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  or  'Nang ga ai fair kau. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Offer kau decide kau ya ai [Accept] or [Reject]
  - Example: 'Nang ga ai reasonable kau. [Accept]'
            'Too unfair kau. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Kumla {round_number} hte kumhkring! ---
Masha {proposer_id} hpung masha, masha {responder_id} jaw masha.
round.offer: Kumla {round_number}: Masha {proposer_id} hpung jaw ${offer} kasa masha {responder_id} (hpung masha ${keep} kasa).
round.accepted: Masha {responder_id} jaw hte hkring! Kumla {round_number} hte kumhkring: Masha {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain} kasa, masha {responder_id} +${responder_gain} kasa. Kumla hte kumhkring galaw gawng: Masha 0: ${total_0} kasa, masha 1: ${total_1} kasa.
round.rejected: Masha {responder_id} jaw hte hkring hpung jaw kasa! Kumla {round_number} hte kumhkring: Kumla hte kumhkring masha $0 kasa. Kumla hte kumhkring galaw gawng: Masha 0: ${total_0} kasa, masha 1: ${total_1} kasa.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Proposer gaw [Offer: $X] ngu ai hkrang hte offer galaw ra na re.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ahkaw ahkang jaw da ai gumhpraw gaw, teng man ai jahpan nambat rai ra ai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Dai kumhpa gaw $0 hte ${pool} lapran hta rai ra ai.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ya aten hta mahtai jaw na lam n nga ai.

outcome.win: Masha {winner} hpung masha ${winner_total} kasa hte masha {loser} ${loser_total} kasa.
outcome.draw: Ndai ginsup ai hta, marai lahkawng yan ${total} hte dang la ma ai.
